subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enmity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Friendship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enmity"** means a state or feeling of active opposition or hostility towards someone or something. (द्वेष)
 
 
• **Example: **There has been a long history of enmity between the two neighboring countries.
 
 
 
• **"Friendship"** refers to a state of mutual trust and support between allied nations or individuals. (मित्रता)
 
 
• **Example: **Their friendship has lasted for over a decade, despite various challenges.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Enmity'** is **'Friendship'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Friendship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Malignity **(दुष्टता): The state or character of being malign; malevolence; intense ill will.
 
 
• **Example:** His malignity was evident in the way he spread rumors about his colleague.
 
 
 
• **Antipathy **(विरोध): A deep-seated feeling of dislike; aversion.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt a strong antipathy towards the new policy implemented at work.
 
 
 
• **Hostility** (शत्रुता): Hostile behavior; unfriendliness or opposition.
 
 
• **Example:** The hostility between the rival factions led to several confrontations.
